sloka: धुरं धुरेण रथयोर्वक्त्रं वक्त्रेण वाजिनाम् ।पताकाश्च पताकाभिः समेयुः स्थितयोस्तदा ।। ६.११०.७ ।।
transliteration: dhuraṁ dhureṇa rathayorvaktraṁ vaktreṇa vājinām ।patākāśca patākābhiḥ sameyuḥ sthitayostadā ।। 6.110.7 ।।

translations.english: The two chariots stood facing each other on the battlefield once more, the axle of one chariot facing the axle of another chariot, the flag of one with another flag, the standard with another standard, the face of one horse with the face of another horse stood and it seemed as though they were together.
